Name: Aboleth's Eyes
Text: Once per session, see through an ally's eyes until your next turn.

Name: Aesna's Assist
Text: Held: Once per turn, you can aid an ally as a swift action.

Name: Brann's Ballad
Text: Allies within 30 feet gain +1 on saves for one round.

Name: Zoë's Bargain
Text: Reroll one die, and keep the second result.

Name: Hrolf's Hornswaggle
Text: Swap one of your cards with a random card of another player.

Name: The Cartographer
Text: Draw a map of a place you have seen.

Name: Gambler's Coin
Text: Flip a coin: heads, draw a card; tails, discard one.

Name: Second Wind
Text: Regain hit points equal to your level.

Name: Roguish Charm
Text: Held: You have advantage on Bluff checks.
